fieldData.full-article-text: To provide an orderly, reliable genesis launch, our proposal to the public is for Radix operated nodes to bootstrap the network for the first epoch. During that epoch (which will likely be on the order of 2 weeks), the community will have ample time to register validator nodes, claim their XRD tokens, and delegate them. As with the beginning of all epochs, the beginning of the first epoch after genesis will then select an open set of 100 validator nodes from all who have registered, based on the stake delegated to them.

fieldData.name: Will the community be able to somehow pre-register validators or delegate stake at genesis?
